change_summary: Added a second runtime-only candidate-day allocation runner that uses the replayable market-level relative-strength state `qqq_minus_spy_mom10 > 0` to boost only `trend_long` sizing on qualifying days. Entries, exits, ranking, and the accepted A+B cohort-specific sizing rules stayed unchanged. No repository trading logic was kept after measurement.
component: runtime-only monkeypatch of `portfolio_engine.size_signals()` with a day-pointer hook for fixed-snapshot replay; candidate-day state computed from `compute_market_regime()` in `quant/experiments/legacy/exp_20260424_005_runner.py`

delta_metrics.note: This proxy was also active enough to be informative, but the pattern repeated. Both variants improved the middle window, yet both regressed the dominant late-strong tape and broke the old thin window badly enough to turn return negative. The higher multiplier made the middle window look better, but only by increasing the damage elsewhere.

hypothesis: If `offense_minus_defense_breadth` is too bespoke, a cheaper healthy-tape proxy might still route the right sleeve: when `qqq_minus_spy_mom10 > 0`, modestly boost `trend_long` risk on those candidate days. A valid rule should preserve the late-strong window while improving the middle / old windows more consistently than the OMDB proxy.
next_retry_requires: Do not keep sweeping nearby `qqq_minus_spy_mom10` thresholds or `trend_long` boost multipliers by default
If healthy-tape routing is revisited, require a richer candidate-cohort discriminator or an explicit two-sided sleeve-routing rule rather than another one-way trend bonus
Treat this as additional evidence against the family `single-proxy candidate-day trend boosts`
notes: This remained a single-causal-variable experiment: only `trend_long` sizing changed, and only on candidate days whose replayable market-relative-strength state crossed the rule. No entry, exit, ranking, or accepted cohort rule changed.
rejection_reason: Rejected on multi-window stability. Even a simpler, replayable healthy-tape proxy (`QQQ-SPY` relative momentum) does not rescue the monotone trend-boost deployment shape. The family improves one window by over-concentrating into trend in the wrong tapes.
